levels.surface: أبوالعباس محمد بن إبراهيم بن إسحاق الطالقاني

notes: Ruling needed (rule 11): the Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq is in the narrated scene (حضر أبوعبد الله جعفر بن محمد الصادق ... ) and speaks and acts in it; it is not settled whether the report's source is al-Rabi' or the scene only, so the Imam is not written as a link
«أبيه» and «جده» are bare relations with no name (rule 7)
